metadata.case_name: CHAN YUET-LING v. TO SUM-FAI AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: The fractures of the right ribs 7, 8 and 9, have healed and only a well healed fracture of the 8th rib can still be seen on X-Ray.
source: The fractures of the right ribs 7, 8 and 9, have healed and only a well healed fracture of the 8th rib can still be seen on X-Ray.

injuries.description: a tear of the liver; a segment of liver was removed.
source: the serious injuries were a tear of the liver and a tear of the spleen.
A segment of liver was removed.

injuries.description: She fractured the superior and inferior rami of the pubis on the right; the rami are at the front.
source: X-Ray of the pelvis shows that she fractured the superior and inferior rami of the pubis on the right; the rami are at the front.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of pubis without disruption of pelvic ring

injuries.description: an abdominal injury with intra-abdominal bleeding; admitted and operated on the day of admission.
source: She suffered a fracture of some right ribs, a fracture of the Pelvis, and an abdominal injury. There was obviously intra-abdominal bleeding and she was operated on the day of admission.

manifestations.description: Some discomfort with prolonged walking; mild pain in the right lower chest, below the breast, especially with sittings; takes one pain relieving pill about three times a week for this discomfort.
X-Ray shows some fibrosis or thickening of the pleura over the lower fifth of the right lung area; deficient air entry in the lower half of the lower lobe of the right lung.
She has some discomfort in the pelvic region. The fracture of the pelvis healed with the bed rest... she managed to walk with difficulty when she was discharged.
For two months after the accident her bladder was drained by an indwelling catheter.

9 ins. operation scar which is still slightly red stretching from the side of the chest to the centre at the front where it intersects a 9 ins. vertical scar running down the abdomen. The scars are well healed and she has no pain on palpation of the scars.
The loss of the spleen carries a risk in the first two years after removal because of the danger of infection.
She suffers a 1% Impairment of the Whole Man from the distortion of the pelvis.
Madam Chan complains of loss of 'Chung Hay' which literally means central air, but it might be described in English as a loss of life force.

treatments_received: admitted and operated on the day of admission
a segment of liver was removed
an incision was made for a thoracotomy
for two months after the accident her bladder was drained by an indwelling catheter
Physiotherapy three times a week for three months
She was given pain relieving pills and vitamins

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities (general damages awarded).
Discomfort with prolonged walking and difficulty walking after pelvic fracture.
Well healed but still slightly red 9 inch scars on chest and abdomen.

comparable_cases.injury_description: general pattern of awards under this head in cases of severe disablement showing a range of awards for serious injury
plaintiff was now an invalid and would have to be institutionalized in a few months and whose life expectancy was markedly reduced
